recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid #FDFBF7 (off-white) using a blank layout.
2. Add the title text box 'How to Kernelize SVM': centered horizontally at the top of the slide, large bold sans-serif, font color #C0392B.
3. Add the slide-number badge: a small circle shape at the top-right corner, fill #F1C40F (yellow), containing the text '35' in #2C3E50.
4. Draw one large container rectangle below the title covering most of the slide: no fill, blue border #2980B9; divide its interior into three stacked horizontal bands (upper, middle, lower) separated by blue #2980B9 horizontal border lines.
5. UPPER BAND / top: insert a wide white rectangle with blue #2980B9 border spanning the full band width; render inside it the equation \mathscr{L}_D(\alpha) = \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i - \frac{1}{2} \sum_{j=1}^N \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i \alpha_j y_i y_j X_i^T X_j in serif math font, color #2C3E50. No highlight on this copy.
6. UPPER BAND / middle: place two white rectangles with blue #2980B9 borders side by side — LEFT box: W = \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i y_i X_i; RIGHT box: b = -\frac{1}{2} [\max_{i: y_i=-1} W^T X_i + \min_{i: y_i=+1} W^T X_i]. Serif math font, #2C3E50. No highlights on this copy.
7. UPPER BAND / bottom: add a rectangle filled #FDEBD0 (light orange/peach) with a thin border, left-aligned below the two formula boxes, containing the text 'Class of vector Z => sign(W^T Z + b)' in #2C3E50. No highlight on this copy.
8. MIDDLE BAND / header: add the text 'Remember :' in italic sans-serif, color #2980B9 (blue).
9. MIDDLE BAND / row 1: add the italic label 'Mapping' in red #C0392B, followed on the same line by the body text 'Instead of using X_i (of dimension d) use \phi(X_i) (with higher dimension )' in #2C3E50 sans-serif, then the inline equation X_i^T X_j \Rightarrow \phi(X_i)^T \phi(X_j) in serif math font.
10. MIDDLE BAND / row 2: add the italic label 'Kernelization' in red #C0392B, followed by the body text 'Instead of using \phi(X_i)^T \phi(X_j) use K(X_i^T , X_j) (Where K is one of kernel functions)' in #2C3E50 sans-serif.
11. LOWER BAND / top: repeat the step-5 wide white/blue-bordered equation box with the identical objective equation, then draw one green oval (outline #2ECC71, no fill) around the term X_i^T X_j at the end of the equation.
12. LOWER BAND / middle: repeat the step-6 side-by-side white/blue-bordered boxes with the identical W and b equations; inside the b box draw two green ovals (outline #2ECC71, no fill), one around each occurrence of W^T X_i.
13. LOWER BAND / bottom: repeat the step-7 peach #FDEBD0 classification box with the identical text 'Class of vector Z => sign(W^T Z + b)'; draw one green oval (outline #2ECC71, no fill) around W^T Z inside the sign(...) expression.
14. Global typography: sans-serif (Calibri or Arial) for all non-equation text; serif math font (Computer Modern style) for all equations; body text color #2C3E50; all body text left-aligned; no bullet markers anywhere on the slide.
